howto.goal: Match symbols on a payline and win chips. Three jackpot symbols on a line pay the most.
howto.setup: Every spin costs the stake you pick, paid in chips from the Jackpot wallet.

sections.title: Choose a stake
sections.text: The bet ladder runs from 25 chips up. A spin costs exactly that stake, so pick an amount you can keep paying.

sections.title: Paylines
sections.text: Classic has nine windows and five paylines. Hermes Olympus has one row of three robot reels and one payline.

sections.title: Honest odds
sections.text: Each machine plays fixed reel strips and publishes the session's own odds. There are no pulls and no earned counters: chips are the only currency.

controls: Click a bet button to set the stake.
Click Spin to pull the reels, or tick Auto-spin to spin on every message.
Pick a machine above the reels: Classic or Hermes Olympus.

demo.intro: Set a stake and take one spin.

lines.say: The machine is ready. The default stake is the minimum bet.
The stake is set at 25 chips; the next spin costs that much.
The reels turn. Any symbols that line up pay from the table.

demo.outro: The machine never ends: change the stake, change the machine, or spin again.

steps.say: Press spin to pull the reels and see the published paytable.
Use the bet ladder to choose what each spin costs.
Three jackpot symbols on a payline pay the biggest prize.
